title: Nexora Ride & Delivery
short_description: Request rides and deliveries, follow your journey, and manage driver jobs.
full_description:
Nexora brings rides and deliveries into one app for customers and approved drivers in Pakistan. Availability depends on nearby drivers and supported routes.

For customers
• Choose pickup and destination, then review the fare before requesting.
• Follow ride and package progress and check driver and vehicle details.
• Use handoff PINs for rides and deliveries.
• View journey history and receipts, and send support requests.

For approved drivers
• Go online when ready to receive work.
• Review assigned rides and deliveries and confirm each handoff.
• View earnings and cash collection details.
• On Android, an ongoing notification keeps the driver shift visible while location and job updates continue when you switch apps or lock the screen. Going offline or signing out stops updates.

When the signal is weak
Recent journey details and route drafts can remain available on your device. Saved details are marked as such. New bookings, live tracking, matching and handoff confirmations require internet and server confirmation. Nexora does not provide offline navigation maps.

Location is requested when you use a location feature. Driver notifications are optional. You can delete a customer or driver account from the app or the linked account deletion page, subject to resolving active jobs and outstanding transactions.

Support: tanzeelsam@gmail.com
Nexora support is not an emergency service.
